_comment: Human-reviewed corrections to catalog.json, keyed by row id (cult:<name>) and applied after the deterministic rules. Each entry needs a note. Allowed fields: assetKind, sectionKind, components, spineAffinities, conversion {status, reason}, portQueue (genui-port | css-surface | app-only; primitive and app rows only). conversion.status cannot be insertable or pending-fetch. An id that is not in the catalog fails the import. See src/overrides.ts.

cult:agent-suggest-card-stack.note: AI agent suggestion stack; the ai category does not enter the static site planner.

cult:ai-blob-warp.note: Paper Design Warp shader avatar (WebGL); shaders stay out of the GenUI vanilla budget.

cult:ai-blob-warp-demo.note: Demo of the WebGL shader avatar cult:ai-blob-warp; the converter classes it app-only by its ai- name, which a primitive row ignores, so it would stay unconverted. It needs the same shader fallback as its component.

conversion.reason: demo of a WebGL shader primitive (cult:ai-blob-warp); a static adapter must supply a fallback

cult:analytics-chart.note: Analytics line chart with tooltip cards; needs a data source and chart runtime a static marketing build cannot promise.

cult:animated-badge.note: Small badge with a gradient rim and a live status dot; the rim and dot pulse are CSS keyframes and the optional layout animation is a class toggle, so a vanilla mount(el, opts) fits the 8 KB JS / 6 KB CSS budget.

cult:animated-button.note: Button with animated gradient rim, frosted fill, staggered label and a loading spinner; label stagger is per-glyph spans set by mount(), the rest is CSS, well inside budget.

cult:animated-card.note: Card surface with an animated gradient rim, frosted fill and layered shadow; the rim animates in CSS and the Base UI action buttons are ordinary buttons.

cult:animated-composer.note: Prompt composer with a shader avatar and send/attach chrome; chat/composer behavior is app-only.

cult:animated-dropzone.note: File dropzone; uploads need an application backend.

cult:animated-field.note: Label/description/error layout for animated inputs; pure CSS layout, no behavior.

cult:animated-input.note: Frosted input and textarea with a gradient rim; styles native form controls with no script.

cult:animated-notification.note: Notification surface with rim variants and a glyph stagger; the enter/exit is a class toggle plus CSS transitions, no AnimatePresence needed.

cult:animated-progress.note: Progress bar with a determinate fill and an indeterminate gradient strip; a spring easing is the shared linear() fallback, so a vanilla port is small.

cult:animated-search.note: Search input with a Warp shader avatar (WebGL) and live-results behavior; shader plus search backend.

cult:animated-segmented.note: Segmented control with a sliding thumb over native radio inputs; the thumb position is one custom property updated on change.

cult:animated-select.note: Port as a styled native <select> with the gradient rim and staggered label; the custom Base UI popup is dropped and the metadata must say so.

cult:animated-switch.note: Toggle switch on a native checkbox with role=switch; the spring thumb is a CSS transition with the shared spring easing.

cult:animated-tabs.note: Tabs with an underline or pill indicator; a vanilla roving-tabindex tablist plus one indicator element fits the budget.

cult:animated-toast.note: Sonner-backed toasts that need a root toaster and app events; no static trigger to promise.

cult:animated-toggle-group.note: Single-select toggle group with a sliding thumb; same vanilla shape as animated-segmented.

cult:border-beam-input.note: Input with a line or full border beam; the beam is the shared conic-gradient treatment around a native input.
